name: park10-iot-suite
description: Suite de Control de Estacionamiento por QR e IoT (Cliente y Tótem)

scripts.sync:cliente: powershell -Command "Copy-Item cliente-app/index.html, cliente-app/styles.css, cliente-app/app.js, cliente-app/qr-scanner.js, cliente-app/iot-service.js, cliente-app/firebase-service.js, cliente-app/qrcode.bundle.js, cliente-app/jsqr.bundle.js -Destination cliente-app/android/app/src/main/assets/ -Force"
scripts.sync:totem: powershell -Command "Copy-Item totem-app/index.html, totem-app/totem.js, totem-app/styles.css, totem-app/escpos-printer.js, totem-app/firebase-totem.js, totem-app/qrcode.bundle.js -Destination totem-app/android/app/src/main/assets/ -Force"
scripts.sync:all: npm run sync:cliente && npm run sync:totem
